summary: Large asphalt gardens car park beside bush; no homes nearby.
reasons: Big sealed car park, easy access

drivers.seclusion: Pin is in thick bush above the auditorium; car park backs onto bush. No dwellings mapped or seen.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road reaches the car park, many marked bays; plenty of room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Visitor traffic by day; quiet road end otherwise. Busy road lies further north.
drivers.convention: Public car park (fee no, access yes); many cars park there so a van blends in.

flags: Slope data is around the pin, mean 5.6%; car park looks flatter
Gardens visitor car park, may be patrolled or closed at night
Gates mapped nearby with a way round
sun_shade: Open asphalt, sun all day; palms and bush shade some edges.
cannot_judge: Night closure or signs on site

best_section.where: Edge of the big asphalt car park north-east of the pin, beside the bush
